correctness.rationale: For the ordinary complete six-vertex directed-forest matching complex with one outgoing arrow per source, simultaneously swapping three vertex pairs yields 15 two-arrow orbits, 12 admissible orbit vertices, and 36 two-orbit compatible edges, with no three-orbit face because every 3-source functional quotient contains a cycle. The resulting connected graph has rank 36-12+1=25. The residual centralizer action (S3 permuting pairs and binary flips modulo diagonal) is AGL(2,2)=S4 and acts simplicially. For each conjugacy class, the signed edge trace identity tr(H1)=1-tr(C0)+tr(C1) gives (25,-1,-3,1,1); pairing with the rational S4 character table yields (1,1,3,4,1), dimension25, with one invariant rational line. Independently enumerated all 30 directed arcs and 15 orbits, all 66 candidate pairs, all 24 group elements and their signed cellular traces, reproducing all five class sizes/values. Inspected complete 5852-byte verify_s4.py, which additionally checks connected spanning tree and direct integral cycle-basis traces. The finite enumeration exhausts this one finite graph and does not assert a general formula.
